A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''individual''' lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="DL" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the individual was chosen as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Roan Shryne]].<ref name="DL" /> In 22 BBY,<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assembled a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from [[Death/Legends|execution]] after his capture by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The Padawan, Shryne and Shryne's former master [[Nat-Sem]] were part of this strike team.<ref name="DL" />

The rescue mission turned into a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|full-scale battle]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], and the Padawan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the battle alongside Nat-Sem and many other [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]. Shryne survived, but the loss of his pupil and his former master, coupled with the death of [[Roan Shryne's second Padawan|another student]] [[Battle of Manari|later]] during the war, led to the Jedi Master losing his faith in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="DL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Padawan was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DL" />
